body.p: , completing and for these clauses. No IR kind added; contract in src/xquery_flwor_internal.h: lowering in src/xquery_lower_window.c, two internal native rows in src/xquery_flwor.c in no function table (a STATIC_CALL targets the row: Q{}group-by#3, Q{}window#4).

item.p: group by stays a tuple stream clause. Its grouping specifications are bindings of the segment before it (a value is a let, 4.13.8's rewrite); after the last, each grouping variable is rebound to its grouping key: coerced to xs:anyAtomicType? (atomized, XPTY0004 for two items), and to a declared type again (so as attribute(*) is XPTY0004); XQST0094 when no variable of the FLWOR has the name. Tuple arrays before a group by pack every variable, constants too. The row takes the tuple arrays, the key member numbers and one collation URI per key ("" = default collation; XQST0076 for one sxml_collation_find does not know, relative URIs against the static base URI) and returns one tuple array per group, same layout, groups in the order of their first tuples: the first tuple's keys, every other member the concatenation of its values. Keys are equal when both empty or atomic-equal, strings under a non-codepoint collation by collation key, dates and times without timezone given the implicit one (fn:deep-equal); hashed as fn:distinct-values does.

Window clauses are not tuple stream clauses (glossary): a clause of a segment like for (4.13.4.3), a MAP over the window arrays (glossary ) the window row returns; the body binds the declared variables by LOOKUP ($w with its type) and lowers the rest of the segment. XQST0103 for two variables of one name. The row's kind bits: sliding, has end, only end. Without end clause a tumbling window ends before the next start; tumbling only end without an end item stops.

Condition closures (glossary): one lowering procedure for window start and end conditions (4 and 8 parameters named by the window variables; the row takes the effective boolean value) and the while clause (: tuple unpacked from parameter 1; its body is now conditional(C, true(), false()), not fn:boolean(C)), so capture analysis and focus capture exist once; sxml_xquery_unpack_tuple is shared.

Measured (3.13's --spec=XQ40, release): prod-GroupByClause 35/40 (not run 2; group-020 is a prolog, group-025 a UCA tailoring, use-case-groupby-Q4 an evaluator SORT over an empty input: sxml_sort_finish allocates 0 bytes, INVALID_ARGUMENT); prod-WindowClause 125/158 (19 not run, the 14 errors are prologs). The FLWOR sets are as measured.
